items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1961-05-22
items.q: before that George wasn't operating no band he was playing with different fellas until after he got with Bunk.

ctx.x: I never had played with George. Yeah, I did play with him a while at Maness, like that, but before that George wasn't operating no band he was playing with different fellas until after he got with Bunk.
When did you play with him at Maness? That must have been a while back. Was Jim in the band then or was it just five pieces or what?

items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1958-12-22
items.q: He had a fine tongue, something like bunk.

ctx.x: Did he play very loud or soft mostly or what was it? Very?
No he could go loud and get soft in any way. He had a fine tongue, something like bunk. Yeah.
